hook.text: Why does Rheingau Riesling face south?
hook.answer: Between Wiesbaden and Rüdesheim the Rhine flows west for about 30 km, so the vineyards on its north bank face south; the Taunus hills shelter them from cold north winds.
hook.source: Open Wine Atlas details-de.json atlas_note and study.json lesson germany-austria-rhine (Rheingau section)
